title: ARIA-Watchdog additional detectors (rejection_repeat + phase_asymmetry) — DEFERRED to V10.6 after MVP FP-rate calibration
raised_by: V10.5 plan v2 6-agent adversarial audit + 24h budget realism analysis
context: V10.5 Phase 1 watchdog ships 2 detectors (stall + bridge_warning_repeat). The v1 plan proposed 4 detectors (adding rejection_repeat + phase_asymmetry). The audit determined these additional detectors are higher FP-risk and should land AFTER the MVP 2-detector FP-rate is measured via 48h soak. AISAFETY-HIGH-010 specifically flagged phase_asymmetry as FP-amplification-prone if not properly excluded from legitimate terminal states.

audit_findings_driving_deferral: AISAFETY-HIGH-010 — phase_asymmetry detector lacks legitimate-terminal-state allowlist (HUMAN_REQUIRED, EXTERNAL_OUTAGE, CONVERGED) → FP amplification feeds AISAFETY-CRIT-003 loop
TEST-CRIT-005 — No success-case test for phase_asymmetry detector (FP 100% bug invisible)
MED-001 — 33% FP rate acceptance ceiling already tight; 4 detectors with un-calibrated FP would compound
deferred_to_v10_6: detect_phase_asymmetry (agent_result_accepted for role X without expected downstream event in 60s, with LEGITIMATE_TERMINAL_STATES allowlist)

prerequisites_for_v10_6_unlock: FP rate ≤ 25% (tightened from V10.5 MVP's 33% — adding more detectors only on cleaner baseline)
Suppression-storm rate stable (no flapping; storm finding emits <1/24h on average)

detect_repeated_rejection_invariants: Fires when same rejection_reasons[0] across ≥3 cycles
Does NOT fire when reasons are different despite same request_id
Skips EXTERNAL_OUTAGE-marked cycles (cross-phase with Phase 3 F-023)
detect_phase_asymmetry_invariants: Fires when agent_result_accepted role X without expected downstream event in 60s
Does NOT fire when downstream event arrives within 60s (success case)
Skips when derive_request_state ∈ {HUMAN_REQUIRED, EXTERNAL_OUTAGE, CONVERGED, ABANDONED_BY_OPERATOR}
Skips when cycle is in active api_backoff_engaged within 600s
